Getting Started with docdesigner

Source: vignettes/getting-started.Rmd
getting-started.Rmd

docdesigner has three outputs:

  • docdesigner::pdf creates a designed PDF document.
  • docdesigner::html creates plain body HTML for WordPress or another CMS.
  • docdesigner::snapshot creates the official Snapshot PDF and, by default, a plain HTML companion.

The main design principle is short YAML. A field should appear in YAML only when it changes the document, identifies the document, or helps publishing.

Start a Document

Create a starter:

docdesigner::designer_use(template = "pdf")
docdesigner::designer_use(template = "html")
docdesigner::designer_use(template = "snapshot")

Or use RStudio:

File > New File > R Markdown > From Template

Minimal PDF YAML 

---
title: "Document Title"
author: "Your Name"
output:
  docdesigner::pdf:
    style: policy
---

Minimal HTML YAML 

---
title: "Article Title"
author: "Your Name"
output:
  docdesigner::html
---

Minimal Snapshot YAML 

---
title: "Finding-Forward Headline"
author: "Your Name"
snapshot_feature: "figures/chart.png"
snapshot_data_note: "Data: source note."
output:
  docdesigner::snapshot:
    html: true
---

Snapshot has one official style. Do not add style or accent to Snapshot YAML unless you are deliberately testing template internals.

Check Your Setup

Run:

docdesigner::designer_check()

This checks package assets, style bundles, rmarkdown, Pandoc, and common LaTeX engines.
